thread:
Paul (AE): Heads-up — FinEdge pilot kickoff next week. They want a tiny POC: stream order events, call back to their 'refund' service via function-call, and emit structured events compatible with their Kafka schema. Also need pricing estimate and security signoff.
Sam (SE): Happy to own SDK integration. Quick Q: do they insist on websocket or are they fine with SSE? Their edge proxy might only support one.
Paul (AE): FinEdge ops said proxy only supports HTTP streaming (SSE), but they can add websocket support if we show value.
Rina (DevRel): We should provide both examples. I'll prepare a lightweight sandbox repo with Rust (websocket) and Go (SSE) examples.
Sam (SE): Note: Go SDK SSE path currently drops empty heartbeat frames in 1.2.0 — workaround is to rehydrate on client by concatenating chunked messages until you see the "end_of_event" marker. I'll include snippet.
Sam (SE): Handshake example (HTTP):
POST /v1/connect HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "transport":"sse", "features": ["structured","tool_calls"], "model":"redwood-serve-lite" }

Sam (SE): Sample streamed structured event we emit (single-line for SSE):
{"meta":{"seq":42,"ts":"2026-03-01T12:34:56Z"},"event":{"type":"tool_call","name":"create_refund","payload":{"order_id":"ORD-5566","amount":45.5}},"status":"complete"}

Paul (AE): They asked for ordering guarantees — they apply events in strict sequence in their ledger. Can we provide strong ordering?
Jia (SRE): We can add monotonic seq numbers and an at-most-once delivery mode if they choose a pinned session (single connection). For high throughput we use partitioned producers with per-partition ordering only. We'll document tradeoffs.
Maria (Security): Security checklist: they require KMS-backed envelope encryption, RBAC for API keys, audit logs (90d), and SAML + SCIM. We'll need to show architecture diagram and implement an allowlist for their proxy IPs. Also confirm retention policy for logs.
Alex (Sales Eng): Pricing: pilot covered by credits up to 50k tokens/day for 2 weeks. If they exceed sustained throughput we propose a 3-month reserved instance at X GPU units. I'll model costs after we get qps estimates.
Rina (DevRel): I can add a sample idempotency header example: X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>. Recommend clients generate per-toolcall to avoid duplicate side-effects.
Sam (SE): Failure modes: if function endpoint returns 5xx, default is NACK and we surface a tool_failure event to the stream. We can optionally auto-retry with exponential backoff if the caller opts in. Will surface in SDK config.
Paul (AE): Pilot blockers checklist for FinEdge: 1) sec questionnaire answers 2) ephemeral creds flow demo 3) confirm SSE vs WS 4) credit approval 5) sample mapping to their Kafka schema.
Jia (SRE): I'll author runbook notes: token TTLs, allowlist steps, VPC peering option for Private, and a canary scaling plan.
Maria (Security): I'll start filling the questionnaire and request the KMS diagram from infra. Also need Legal on the NDA — looping Legal now.
Rina (DevRel): Repo plan: examples/ (rust-ws/, go-sse/), sandbox/handshake.sh, docs/mapping.md with example Kafka Avro mapping. I'll open the PR and link it in the invite.
Alex (Sales Eng): I'll confirm credits and draft a short SOW for reserved if needed.
Sam (SE): I'll send the SDK snippets and a small test harness that replays events to their dev env by EOD.
Paul (AE): Let's meet tomorrow 11am PT with FinEdge devs. I'll send invite with repo + preliminary questionnaire answers.
bridge-bot: Meeting scheduled: FinEdge POC sync — Wed 11:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood/finedge-poc
Paul (AE): Appreciate it everyone — will update thread if Legal/NDA come back.
